verdict.reason: Baleal is worth a quick check for evening — 19:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is part of the picture, but not the deciding factor.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d do a quick cam check before heading out, because Baleal evening is the best available option but the wind angle looks poor and it can get soft/sectiony on the sandbanks around mid tide. Surfline and MEO aren’t saying great things, so I’d only leave if the cams look noticeably cleaner than expected. If it’s messy on camera, I’d save the drive—wind is the main thing likely to ruin it.

best.explanation: Baleal looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 164 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 76/100, and wind is the main risk.  A broad, forgiving beach setup with several peaks; this is best for spreading out and finding a manageable wave when the bay has enough push; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the Baleal sandbanks.
